description: Notification and ad links to /quizzes: drop a query string made only of the page's own link parameters (openQuiz, upcoming) and tracking parameters, so the page cache rule serves them. The page reads them in the browser (deploy/CLOUDFLARE_PAGE_CACHE.md)
expression: (http.host eq "1think2win.com" and http.request.uri.path eq "/quizzes" and http.request.uri.query ne "" and all(http.request.uri.args.names[*] in {"openQuiz" "upcoming" "utm_source" "utm_medium" "utm_campaign" "utm_term" "utm_content" "utm_id" "fbclid" "mibextid" "gclid" "gbraid" "wbraid" "gad_source" "msclkid" "ttclid" "twclid" "igsh" "igshid" "li_fat_id"}))
